column1: # Every cipher suite OpenSSL 3.5.3 lists, in its own spelling and the IANA one:
# 159 suites; the five TLS 1.3 suites spell both columns alike. Every name in either column is a
# suite and must be served NAME-CIPHER-SUITE. Weak suites are compiled out of this build, so
# RC4-*, DES-CBC*-SHA, SEED-SHA and the export suites are pinned in the test itself.
